name: YNX Security Platform
title: YNX Security Platform | Release Integrity and Reliability
metaDescription: Security, release integrity, observability, incident response, and recovery controls for YNX testnet products.
features: backup, restore, incident, and rollback controls
risks: installed only as a local CLI candidate, not in an approved staging cluster
current source artifact is test-signed, not production-signed
live cross-region restore evidence is pending

faq.question: Is the YNX Security Platform publicly deployed?
faq.answer: No. The current candidate is implemented, tested, and installed as a local CLI, but central integration, staging, and public deployment are not yet verified.

faq.question: Is the current artifact production-signed?
faq.answer: No. The current source archive uses an ephemeral local test signature and is not eligible for public release.

faq.question: What release evidence is available?
faq.answer: The current candidate includes a reproducible source archive, SHA-256 digest, CycloneDX SBOM, provenance statement, test-signature verification, tamper-rejection tests, and successful protected-branch CI for the exact source commit.
